classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory determination that the covered persons’ unrestricted entry is not detrimental, producing the operative legal predicate immediately rather than directing a later agency outcome.
classifications.evidence: hereby find that the unrestricted entry into the United States of persons described in section 1 of Proclamation 10014 is not detrimental to the interests of the United States

classifications.rationale: The President immediately revokes the cited proclamations and provisions, thereby removing their entry suspension without requiring a later agency decision.
classifications.evidence: Proclamation 10014, section 1 of Proclamation 10052, and section 1 of Proclamation 10131 are revoked.

classifications.rationale: The named Secretaries must conduct an internal review and may revise agency guidance as appropriate; no specified later legal outcome is dictated, while the remaining language preserves existing executive authorities and functions.
classifications.evidence: shall review any regulations, orders, guidance documents, policies, and any other similar agency actions developed pursuant to Proclamation 10014
